content_of_post_to_comment: Is it just me, or has mainstream music not only gotten so bad, but it’s also kinda matching up with how dumbed down everything feels now? Like it’s conforming to people who don’t want any depth anymore.
comment: Maybe the deeper shift is that music is increasingly designed to survive being half-listened to. When every platform rewards what grabs attention instantly, subtlety becomes a commercial risk rather than an artistic virtue.
